dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, what do you do at lunchtime?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt duː juː ˈduː ət ˈlʌntʃtaɪm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I usually eat with Emma at the cafeteria.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ˈiːt wɪð ˈɛmə ət ðə ˌkæfəˈtɪriə.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I study in the library. We have a test on Friday.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈstʌdi ɪn ðə ˈlaɪbrɛri. wiː ˈhæv ə ˈtɛst ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, but next week is sports day. I play volleyball!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt ˈnɛkst ˈwiːk ɪz ˈspɔːrts ˌdeɪ. aɪ ˈpleɪ ˈvɑːlibɔːl!
